text: Acme Analytics is billed annually on the enterprise plan; the subscription renews every year on March 1st and auto-renews unless cancelled at least 30 days prior.
Invoices for Acme must be sent to accounts-payable@acme.example and reference a purchase order number, or the finance team rejects them.
The primary contact at Acme is Dana Ruiz, VP of Engineering. Dana prefers Slack over email for anything urgent.
Acme wants all generated reports written in British English and exported as PDF, never as DOCX.
Dashboards for Acme should use the brand colour 0B5FFF for primary charts and avoid orange.
To deploy Acme's staging environment, merge to the release branch and the GitHub Action promotes it automatically after CI passes.
Acme's incident runbook: page the on-call engineer via PagerDuty, open a Slack war-room channel, and post a status update every 30 minutes until resolved.
Acme's fiscal year ends on January 31st; quarterly business reviews happen in the first week of February, May, August, and November.
The last Salesforce sync for Acme pulled 1204 opportunities and the pipeline value came to 4.2 million dollars.
When summarising Acme's weekly metrics, exclude internal test accounts whose emails end in acme.internal, or the active-user count is inflated.
Acme's monthly-report playbook: pull usage from the warehouse, compare it to the prior month, and flag any metric that moved more than 15 percent.
Acme has 47 seats provisioned: 12 are admin seats and the remaining 35 are analyst seats.
Dana's manager at Acme is Priya Nair, the CTO, who signs off on any contract change above 50000 dollars.
Acme does not want any AI-written content published externally without a human review step first.
Bloom and Co ships same-day for orders placed before 11am local time; anything after that ships the next business day.
Bloom's courier is PetalExpress for local deliveries and FedEx for anything over 50 miles away.
Bloom's best-selling arrangement is the Sunrise Bouquet, which uses seasonal tulips and ranunculus.
The Midnight Garden arrangement is only available from October to December and uses dark dahlias.
Bloom wants product descriptions written in a warm, playful tone and always kept under 40 words.
To restock, Bloom emails its wholesaler Verdant Supplies every Monday with the coming week's flower list.
The owner of Bloom is Mia Chen. Mia handles all wedding enquiries personally and wants them flagged immediately.
Bloom offers a 10 percent loyalty discount to a customer after their fifth completed order.
The last inventory sync for Bloom showed 340 stems of roses and only 12 stems of peonies left in stock.
When drafting Bloom's promotional emails, never promise next-day delivery on public holidays because the courier does not run then.
Bloom's abandoned-cart playbook: wait 4 hours, send a reminder with a 5 percent code, then stop after a single follow-up.
Bloom's return policy: fresh flowers are non-refundable, but a wilted-on-arrival photo sent within 24 hours earns a free replacement.
Bloom's brand voice avoids the word cheap; use affordable or great value instead.
Mia's wholesale account number with Verdant Supplies is VS-88213.
Northstar Consulting bills senior consultants at 320 dollars an hour and analysts at 180 dollars an hour.
Northstar's fixed-fee discovery engagement is priced at 25000 dollars for a four-week sprint.
The managing partner at Northstar is Sam Okafor. Sam signs every statement of work before it goes to a client.
Northstar's deliverables must follow the firm template: an executive summary first and an appendix of raw data last.
Northstar logs billable hours in Harvest daily; anything not logged by Friday at 5pm is written off.
Northstar's largest client is Meridian Bank, a retainer worth 40000 dollars a month.
When preparing Northstar's client decks, redact any client name other than the recipient's, because cross-client references breach the NDA.
Northstar's proposal playbook: scope call, a one-page brief, a fixed-fee quote, then a follow-up within 48 hours.
The last time-tracking export for Northstar showed the team logged 612 billable hours across 5 clients last month.
Northstar prefers charts in greyscale for print decks and colour only for the on-screen version.
Sam's executive assistant at Northstar is Lena Fox, who schedules all partner meetings.
Northstar's standard payment terms are net-30; Meridian Bank negotiated net-45.
Northstar's onboarding for a new client starts with a data-room request and an NDA signed by both parties.
Northstar has 9 consultants: 3 partners, 2 senior consultants, and 4 analysts.
